what: Pilot Runs of the step 2 comparison (ticket 11 of .scratch/seele-und-kappa/). Pilot seeds 901 to 923 never count.
notes: T is the pass time of step 1 within generation 1000, null for never.

minutes: wall time of the brut-breed process as the pilot driver measured it, two Runs at a time on 4 cores, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=2 each; minutes_timings: the sum of timings.jsonl, which leaves out the start and the select phase.

divergence: the first generation whose newborns differ, member by member in birth order, in gene id, operator, parents (by gene id), answers, solved count or graded value; null when no generation differs.
votes: the sums over the born events of the vote tallies (complex, flipped, tied, sim_decided); first_flip and first_sim_decided: the first generation whose state line counts one.
soul_every_10th: the soul group of the state line of every 10th generation, one row per line in the order of soul_columns; floats rounded to 4 decimal places.
sha256: the five record files, hashed by the driver before events.jsonl and snapshot.json were compressed with xz.
